description: Painel Metabase com indicadores de SLOs, lineage e status de incidentes

tiles.title: Freshor Status por Tabela
tiles.query: SELECT table_name, freshness_target_max_age_minutes as max_age_min, COUNT(*) as breach_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '✅' ELSE '❌' END as status FROM slo_catalog_view GROUP BY table_name, freshness_target_max_age_minutes
tiles.description: Indica se cada tabela está dentro do target de frescor (>95% dados com menos de 1h)

tiles.title: Volume por Lote
tiles.query: SELECT table_name, min_rows_per_batch as min_expected, COUNT(*) as actual_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= min_rows_per_batch THEN '✅' ELSE '❌' END as status FROM batch_metrics GROUP BY table_name, min_rows_per_batch
tiles.description: Verifica se o volume por batch está acima do mínimo esperado

tiles.title: Expectations Suites Status
tiles.query: SELECT table_name, suite_name, failed_expectations, total_expectations, CASE WHEN failed_expectations = 0 THEN '✅' ELSE '❌' END as status FROM expectation_results ORDER BY table_name, suite_name
tiles.description: Status das suites Great Expectations para cada tabela

tiles.title: Incidentes Recentes
tiles.query: SELECT incident_type, detected_at, resolved_at, (resolved_at - detected_at) as mttr_minutes, status FROM incident_log ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 10
tiles.description: Últimos incidentes simulados com tempo de resolução (MTTR)

tiles.title: Lineage View
tiles.query: SELECT source, bronze, silver, gold FROM openlineage_events WHERE run_id = current_run() ORDER BY event_timestamp
tiles.description: Visualização completa de lineage OpenLineage da origem ao Gold
